name: Accessibility Quality
description: Ship UI that works with keyboard and assistive technology: semantic HTML and native controls first, ARIA only to supplement, logical focus order with visible focus and escape paths, programmatic labels and error association, contrast and non-color meaning, alt text, reduced motion, zoom and reflow. Use for any user-facing UI change and for WCAG audits; never knowingly ship an accessibility regression.
verification_requirements: keyboard-only pass of the changed surface
names, roles, states, and contrast checked for changed controls
